sibyl.notes: Every cited claim is supported by the page texts. Z correctly identifies the finalized WSTS actual ($630,549M, +19.7%) and contrasts it with the Fall 2024 forecast and with regional actuals. The answer discloses that SIA relies on WSTS data and that it found no independent corroboration.
